mapper.select: SELECT LEVEL, C.* FROM (SELECT COMMENT_NO, COMMENT_CONTENT, TO_CHAR(COMMENT_WRITE_DATE, 'YYYY"년" MM"월" DD"일" HH24"시" MI"분" SS"초"') COMMENT_WRITE_DATE, BOARD_NO, MEMBER_NO, MEMBER_NICKNAME, COMMENT_NO2, COMMENT_DEL_FL FROM "COMMENT" JOIN MEMBER USING(MEMBER_NO) WHERE BOARD_NO = #{boardNo}) C WHERE COMMENT_DEL_FL = 'N' OR 0 != (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "COMMENT" SUB WHERE SUB.COMMENT_NO2 = C.COMMENT_NO AND COMMENT_DEL_FL = 'N') START WITH COMMENT_NO2 IS NULL CONNECT BY PRIOR COMMENT_NO = COMMENT_NO2 ORDER SIBLINGS BY COMMENT_NO
